notes.title: Update 6.3: Hazard elements, clearer tutorial, adjusted EXP curve
notes.content:
Hey all!
This time on Skyseeker, we're bringing to you a few small gameplay changes.
[list]
[*] New hazards are now discoverable throughout the map, such as spike plants and bomb fruits. These hazards will damage both you and your enemies, so use them to your advantage!
[*] Tutorial is now more clear on how to capture Fauna, and how to attack directionally.
[*] Capture ball now shows a timer for how long you have left.
[*] There is now a shortcut from the Valley of Lilles to the Grand Crossroads
[*] Capturing a Fauna no longer reduces its level by 2.
[/list]

A huge thanks to everyone who has been playing the demo during the Steam Festival! We've been getting coverage from some great youtube channels. 

Gym Leader Ed: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bW1Ob0y0WOo&feature=youtu.be]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bW1Ob0y0WOo&feature=youtu.be[/url]
DualShot66: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CbYFq6ao8Ao]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CbYFq6ao8Ao[/url]
Monster Tamer Bloba: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aXI2ucn5qZg]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aXI2ucn5qZg&feature=youtu.be[/url]

A new subreddit was made by the community, check it out at [url=https://reddit.com/r/skyseeker]https://reddit.com/r/skyseeker[/url]

As always, hit the wishlist button to support Skyseeker as we push towards the Early Access release!
Kirisame Jump

notes.title: Skyseeker v6.1 : Steam Festival Update
notes.content:
Hey there!

Skyseeker is a monster-collecting metroidvania where every enemy is catchable. Our aim is to combine the joy of team-building in games like Pokemon, with real-time combat and and a vast explorable map. Every monster you catch has unique skills and movement options, and you'll have to create your own squad for winning battles and getting around the world.

We're excited to unveil Skyseeker v6.1, our latest version of the free open beta. Our team's development on Skyseeker has moved rapidly over the past months, and we're finally ready to show off what we got at the Steam Game Festival!

We designed this free build to contain a sizable portion of the game's content, featuring a total of four playable maps to explore. We've made major improvements to multiple aspects of the game, including:
[list]
[*] Overhauling map design
[*] More events and encounters in the world
[*] Blessing unlock system
[*] Fauna tracking system (Faunadex can be filled out!)
[*] Even more blessings
[*] Even more fauna (up to 40+)
[*] Even more fauna evolutions
[*] Rival and side rival characters
[*] Overall game balance
[*] More music 
[*] New water shaders
[*] Elevators and gondolas 
[*] Improved fauna catching system
[/list] 

Play the build here at [url=https://kvfrans.itch.io/skyseeker]https://kvfrans.itch.io/skyseeker[/url]

As always, don't forget to wishlist if you are interested, it helps us out a lot.
Thank you for following Skyseeker!

notes.title: Skyseeker enters Open Beta! Link to build inside.
notes.content:
Howdy.

Skyseeker is entering Open Beta. That means you get to play the game, for free! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/79a0d5048513403d405ca9941a53d6dcb06e4e52.png[/img]

This build features about half of the planned game content. There are four open areas to explore, and every monster you see is catchable. Trainer battles are challenging duels needing both reflexes and team-building. There's an upgrade-based progression system for each monster, evolutions, and two Bell Guardian boss fights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/1ef9ed2859b20503c249ee5de6f6cab729a1978d.png[/img]

Play the Beta build at: https://kvfrans.itch.io/skyseeker

We'd also greatly appreciate feedback, either through [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf_GJemfIt4ZJ_O5cURFxKsi0Pm7udID6NvOomvgUxuyuggOg/viewform]this google form[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.gg/jkY97xH]Discord[/url] server. 

As always, thanks for playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/2cdf800df71322bb0134917b4605653c0268f0f1.png[/img]

notes.title: Skyseeker 3: Collosseum, Blessings, Bug Smashing
notes.content:
Hello hello!

This week on Skyseeker, we are preparing hard for the release of the first Beta. We've knocked out a whole bunch of bugs in the game, and we're super close to getting this build out for you.

A new place this time is the Collosseum! Located in the Explorer Capital, this arena is a place for seasoned trainers to duel each other. The winner receives a coveted prize -- a Skyseeker title.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/fea9bbc30ed3aff4c0e434eaf8dd6e7cc0b252ea.png[/img]

Evolutions should be exciting. They're a big moment! We've made evolutions feel more impactful.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/d4767595e6ed2c98cecf354ed3420f55b2077bbe.png[/img]

A new Blessing system is now in place. Monsters recieve Blessings every 3 levels, which are unique permanent upgrades that stay with the character forever. Select the traits you enjoy to build a team of your own![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/2840a0a4e69e9a63196a31bf383c65ec460364ee.png[/img]

Finally, a new Bell guardian lurks in the Valley of Lilies. What kind of beast could it be...?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/9043a1c771f92e6fdb0ab397365a369d5e1f5d4d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/a1bf8924aa2fa9144a91dad9168f408f50a5a088.png[/img]
On spotlight is the cute and cuddly Tailfist. These territorrial creatures roam old ruins, protecting their area with a powerful punch. They are slow and squishy, but evolve into the dangerous Doublefist!

As always, join the Discord and come talk to us -- https://discord.gg/jkY97xH

notes.title: Skyseeker 2: Worldbuilding and Monster Week
notes.content:
Hi there!

We're hard at work on pushing out the MVP 4B for Skyseeker.  We'll be releasing this build for free to playtesters, and we want the build to be polished and clean. The build will include the first four areas of the game, a whole bunch of monsters, and three bells to ring.

That said, one aspect of this week was focused on worldbuilding. We want to create a World Worth Exploring, and that means taking these fantasties from our heads into reality.

Starstruck Caves, where the Gillshrooms spawn. These flying jellyfish inhabit the moist air of the caverns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/b9b08e6728e43e70d7f6b85a75e065451714274a.png[/img]

A small Skyseeker Hideout, with a giant Bombshroom acting as an elevator. Monsters in Skyseeker are not just for fighting! They place a role in everyday life of the adventurers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/32083994744b4658358dfbc19cbf38b84e8c8a00.png[/img]

The Valley of Lillies, a lush haven of life. Ruins of an old Lifewater aqueduct now supports a growing ecosystem of plants and monsters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/1ef9ed2859b20503c249ee5de6f6cab729a1978d.png[/img]

On the spotlight this week is the majestic Boomer Dog! These creatures roam the plains of the Grand Crossroads, and hunt with their detachable tails. They are fast with a high attack range, so be careful of kiting and go in for a quick melee strike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38337631/33f84c443166577cdc8b6bd823bd580e16760d38.png[/img]

 As always, join the Discord and come talk to us! https://discord.gg/jkY97xH

notes.title: Skyseeker 1: Launch! Play the Beta!
notes.content:
Hello there!

Welcome to the world of the Skyseekers, where majestic creatures lost to time roam the boiling rivers, freezing glaciers, and enormous oceans of fog in the Grand Tree Hyperion.

We'd like to invite you to test out an early Beta build of the game! This prototype focuses on the main mechanics, and only contains a single area. There are about 20 monsters to collect, a rival to fight, and a boss fight at the Bell to signal the adventure's beginning.

Play Skyseeker MVP 4a: https://kvfrans.itch.io/skyseeker

Any feedback is greatly appreciated! We want to make the best experience we can, and hearing your real opinions and thoughts is incredible helpful.

As a plan, we'll be posting weekly updates for the coming months as development continues. Our next milestone is MVP 4b, which will feature three interlinked zones and serve as a full experience, with about a third of the planned content.

As always, join the Discord and talk to us! https://discord.gg/jkY97xH

Till next time,
- Kirisame Jump
